as_read: Positive only in one 18-patient RCT in a rare genetic neuropathy at 400 mg/kg/day; no study meets rule 2 for plain L-serine at label amounts for a general purpose.
stop_list: Dose fields can't express 400 mg/kg/day (30626650); it stays in regimen text.
clinician_items: 28527102: phase I in 20 ALS patients, 0.5 to 15 g twice daily: two withdrew for gastrointestinal side effects; three deaths, which the authors call about the expected number.
34201370: healthy men, graded 3 to 12 g/day over 4-week periods: no treatment-related adverse events; authors set a NOAEL of 12 g/day.
30626650: no serious adverse effects related to L-serine at 400 mg/kg/day in HSAN1.
stored_rating_note: positive_moderate overstates a single 18-patient rare-disease RCT at a weight-based dose; the stored applicability text already says it doesn't establish general benefit.
